what_this_is: Recreations of land cover for three named districts, drawn from per-district class confidences in the added-layer table, each labelled as a re-drawing of a table rather than an observation.
recreations_exist_because: Real crops were exported from the asset for these same districts, so these are not a substitute for missing evidence. They show the numeric class confidences the panel reads, and they stand in as the labelled example whenever a crop cannot be fetched.
